COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Jul-28-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came as reassigment from PJ Department for Court Trial.
Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, CSR: Mitch Lyon, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo
Mercedes A. Gavin, Esq. for Plaintiff BRE/Rincon Leasehold LLC. Autorized Agent Jack Bray also present.
Defendant William Lynam present in pro per.
Parties had reached a settlement by stipulation and all parties agreed to the settlement in open court, main terms read on the record as follows:
Plaintiff is entitled to a future judgment for the property located at: 88 Howard ST. Apt. #2015, San Francisco.
Defendant agrees to vacate on or before August 19, 2003 and return the key before 5 PM.
Defendant to pay the sum of $10,517.30 in installment payments as follows: Defendant to pay $300.00 per month starting on January 1,2004 and thereafter on the first of each month until fully paid. If defendant pays any money in advance that exceeds 20% of the balance reamining, defendant shall be given a 10% discount on that amount and the 10% discount shall act as a credit toward the remianing balance.
Stipulation for judgment and settlement agreement filed.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
